description: MainActivity class for an Android app demonstrating biometric authentication, login/logout, session locking, and navigation logic using ViewModel and lifecycle-aware components.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling user authentication, biometric prompts, session locking, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes views, ViewModel, biometric authenticator, and sets up observers.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles app coming to foreground, enforces re-locking and biometric prompts based on app state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves biometric prompt state across configuration changes.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Marks app as backgrounded for re-locking logic.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Binds UI components to class variables.

methods.name: wireClicks
methods.description: Sets click listeners for UI buttons to trigger ViewModel actions.

methods.name: observeAuthState
methods.description: Collects and reacts to authentication state changes, updating UI and navigation.

methods.name: observeStatusLog
methods.description: Collects status log updates and displays them.

methods.name: setButtonsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables UI buttons based on current state.

methods.name: maybePromptUnlock
methods.description: Initiates biometric prompt if available and session is locked.

methods.name: routeToHomeIfUnlocked
methods.description: Navigates to HomeActivity if session is unlocked.

methods.name: routeToHome
methods.description: Starts HomeActivity and clears activity stack.
